ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of an insect body structure. The visible labels in the figure include Compound eye, Thorax, Leg, Abdomen on the left side, and Antenna, Head, Wing, Haltere on the right side. The label “Leg” points to the leg appendage below/on the side of the insect body. Reasoning: The question asks which body part is used for locomotion (movement) or support (support). Among these labeled body parts, legs are used to move the body and support body weight, so the corresponding answer is Leg.
